snippet.title: Mad Evolution: Idle Merge
snippet.description:
Monsters, merging, and mayhem – The Crazy Idle Evolution Game!
Combine wacky monsters, transform them into strange new forms, and explore unknown worlds! Collect coins endlessly, upgrade all you can, and create your crazy monster empire! 

Android - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.almagames.merge.idle.madness 
iOS - Coming soon
